items.name: Warm-up
items.note: Marching, arm circles, hip circles, shoulder rolls, easy squats.

items.name: Core 5
items.note: Plank, dead bug, bicycle crunch, glute bridge, side plank (swap sides).

items.name: Legs
items.note: Squat, reverse lunge, calf raise, wall sit, step-up, glute bridge.

items.name: Upper body
items.note: Push-up (knees are fine), chair dip, pike push-up, shoulder tap, superman, arm circles.

items.name: Quick HIIT
items.note: Jumping jacks, high knees, squat jumps, mountain climbers. Use low-impact steps if you need to.

items.name: Stretch
items.note: Hamstring, quad, hip flexor, chest opener, shoulder, calf, neck, child's pose.

items.name: Desk break
items.note: Neck rolls, shoulder shrugs, wrist circles, standing hip hinge.

items.name: Walk-jog
items.note: Jog for a minute, walk for a minute. Keep the jog easy enough to talk.
